text:
sam roberts: quick sync needed. Large customer flagged gaps for SOC2/ISO evidence: audit-log schema completeness, retention tiers, per-tenant exportability, and how BYOK affects log provenance. asking for firm acceptance criteria for product roadmap planning.

leah ng: can we capture the ask as concrete acceptance checks? i.e., fields required, retention windows, export format, and proof of key binding.

diego (security): minimum schema we should guarantee for SOC2: timestamp, event_id, tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource_id, outcome, request_id, source_ip, user_agent, key_id (if crypto op), key_version, immutable_signature. all logs must be append-only and integrity-protected.

rachel (compliance): also need tamper-evidence: signed manifests and a chain-of-custody record for every export. retention tiers: 90d (hot), 365d (standard), 7yr (enterprise). default to 365d for compliance baseline.

kevin zhao: engineering notes: appending signature in-line for every log entry expensive. alternative: batched signed checkpoints every 1h with merkle root over entries. need to call out detection windows for tamper.

diego (security): merkle checkpoints OK as long as append-only store + replay protection. require monotonic checkpoint sequence and log-root published to audit-s3 with versioning.

sam roberts: export requirements from customer: single-archive evidence bundle (jsonl logs + manifests + signature), CSV summary for legal, and an index file mapping object->key-version. must be consumable by 3rd-party forensics.

leah ng: how does BYOK affect this?

diego (security): BYOK scenarios: 1) platform-managed keys: we can produce decrypted, indexed logs and sign the export with platform signing key. 2) BYOK (customer KMS): logs that include payloads encrypted under customer keys must remain ciphertext; exports include key_id and key_version, plus a wrapped-decrypt-token placeholder. 3) Escrow path: customer can opt-in to escrow a short-lived unwrap token via our Escrow API; every unwrap requires dual-approval and is fully audited.

rachel (compliance): escrow needs contract addendum. require explicit customer consent + legal hold policy if escrow used. also require role-based approvals for unwraps.

kevin zhao: API sketch for product doc: POST /tenants/:id/audit/config {retention: "90|365|2555", integrity: "merkle|none", escrow_enabled: true|false}, GET /tenants/:id/audit/export?from=...&to=..., POST /escrow/unwrap {export_id, unwrap_token}. Add header X-Signing-Key for signed checkpoints.

sam roberts: acceptance criteria for roadmap PRD (MVP): - consistent schema (diego list) implemented - default retention: 365d - append-only store with hourly signed checkpoint - export API producing evidence bundle (jsonl + manifest + signatures) - BYOK: include key_id metadata, escrow opt-in w/ audit trail - docs + customer playbook + legal review signoff.

leah ng: prioritization ask: is this M1 or M2? one large prospect is blocking on this (enterprise sale). estimated effort?

kevin zhao: rough eng estimate: base schema + hourly checkpointing + export API = 5-6 sprint-equivalents across runtime + storage + api + console. BYOK metadata support + escrow opt-in + legal flow add 2-3 sprints. docs/legal prep parallel. total ~8-9 sprints to GA if nothing else blocks.

diego (security): risk notes: cross-region exports for data-sovereignty, PI redaction rules (we should support a redaction policy per-tenant to remove persisted PII from logs), and cost delta for long retention. include privacy impact assessment.

rachel (compliance): SLA ask from customer: export readiness within 24 hours for legal holds. can we promise that?

kevin zhao: 24h export SLA depends on size and whether escrow unwrap required. propose target SLA: 24h for metadata-only exports; 72h for full decrypted exports when escrow/kms operations required. call this out as contractable enterprise SLA.

sam roberts: please post a one-paragraph PRD summary and a short risk table by EOD. i'll slot this into next planning board and propose M1 conditional on the prospect commit.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for branch feature/audit-root-checkpoints (build 893). :white_check_mark: 

kevin zhao: i'll add sample jsonl snippet and manifest format to the PRD. sample manifest fields: export_id, tenant_id, from_ts, to_ts, merkle_root, signature, key_ids[], file_list[].

leah ng: adding stakeholder owners: sam (product), kevin (eng), diego (security), rachel (compliance). sales to escalate prospect commitment.

sam roberts: thanks all — we'll consolidate and send a draft acceptance matrix to the customer tomorrow. :rocket:
